description: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Traffic Signal Control in Multi-Intersection Environment: A Comparative Study of DQN Variants is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dhidik Prastiyanto, Akhyar Abdillah Manaf (Department of Electrical Engineering, Universitas Negeri Semarang, Semarang 50229, Indonesia). This dataset contains simulation data and trained models for the study "Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Traffic Signal Control in Multi-Intersection Environment: A Comparative Study of DQN Variants". Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
